scripts.build: npm run build -w @aiops/web && npm run build -w @aiops/api
scripts.dev:deps: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres minio
scripts.db:migrate: for f in database/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$AIOPS_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done
scripts.test: npm run build -w @aiops/api && npm run test -w @aiops/api && (cd broker && GOCACHE=/tmp/aiops-dashboard-go-cache go test ./...) && python3 -m unittest discover telemetry/tests
